title: norantea berteroi
intro: Norantea berteroi, commonly known as the Tahitian tea, is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands. It is a member of the Rubiaceae family and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Norantea berteroi include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are said to aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative and analgesic properties.
